failures.trigger: A target-security quote, market capitalization, multiple, implied return, or implied beta enters price-blind evidence.
failures.fail_closed: Reject the Candidate and invalidate the Handoff run.

failures.trigger: Candidate slot, method, concept, scenario, horizon, unit, or evidence role disagree.
failures.fail_closed: Reject the Candidate before human review.

failures.trigger: Supplemental source identity, authority, cutoff, content hash, raw lineage, or closure hash cannot be replayed.
failures.fail_closed: Reject the supplemental closure and every dependent Candidate.

failures.trigger: More than one active human Decision confirms the same assumption slot.
Handoff policy, closure, component, kernel, or protected hash drifts within a run.
failures.fail_closed: Reject the chain and require a new evidence_open root.

failures.trigger: Market access occurs before the canonical price-blind freeze.
failures.fail_closed: Reject MarketReferenceSnapshot and quarantine any observed market evidence.

failures.trigger: A compiler invents a slot, evidence object, value, or scenario rather than replaying registered inputs.
failures.fail_closed: Return blocked Candidate decisions with explicit reason codes.

failures.trigger: An unconfirmed, stale, LLM-reviewed, or fingerprint-mismatched Candidate becomes a kernel assumption.
McKinsey scenarios omit a year, diverge between DCF and economic-profit inputs, or violate pinned terminal preflight.
failures.fail_closed: Keep the McKinsey block partial or blocked.

failures.trigger: Penman hurdle, growth grid, or challenge path is changed after observing price.
failures.fail_closed: Invalidate the run and restart from evidence_open.

failures.trigger: Canonical price-blind bytes or any protected hash cannot be deterministically replayed.
Clean-room replay, input-order independence, unrelated-history independence, or immutable Handoff conservation fails.
failures.fail_closed: Keep Phase 5D open and prohibit Phase 5E authorization.
failures.verification: Phase 5D-6 replay goldens and exact-head read-only audit.
